//==
// # Curves
//
// Sections, in order:
//  - Curves — derived functions for the curve interfaces

library Curves
{
    //==
    // # Curves — derived functions for the curve interfaces
    //
    // Bodies for ICurve1D / ICurve2D / ICurve3D and the two closed-curve markers
    // declared in `curves.concepts.plato`. Every function's first parameter is
    // interface-typed, so each helper becomes available on every implementing type.
    // Endpoints, chords, secants, and finite-difference estimates are all derivable
    // from `Eval` alone; nothing here needs a member the interface does not already
    // declare.
    //
    // The canonical parameter domain of a curve is the unit interval [0,1], and
    // evaluation goes through the `Eval` member inherited from `IProcedural`.

    //==
    // # ICurve1D
    //
    // A real function of one real parameter (IProcedural<Number, Number>).
    // Evaluated over the canonical [0,1] domain; endpoints and central-difference
    // estimates of the slope are the derivable conveniences.

    // The value for a parameter; an intent-revealing alias for Eval.
    ValueAt(self: ICurve1D, t: Number): Number
        => self.Eval(t);
